name: Magic Flute
description: Accessible hands-free electronic wind instrument using breath and head tilt.

documentation.title: Magic Flute: manufacturer or original documentation

notice: Select scales and sounds on the control module. Head tilt chooses pitch and breath controls dynamics. Route the module MIDI output to an external instrument through a DIN MIDI interface. The cited guide does not establish a fixed CC map, so breath CC assignments are intentionally omitted. My Breath My Music is the project/support organization; see its page for supplier information. For computer use, connect MIDI OUT to interface MIDI IN; connect interface MIDI OUT to hardware MIDI IN when controlling the instrument. Port names are intentionally empty: interface or app names do not reliably identify the attached hardware. Select this profile manually. This is partial coverage, not a complete MIDI implementation. The panel is an original simplified schematic. Physical controls are shown without assumed MIDI assignments.
